title: 第3章 万魂幡饮血开锋第4章 兵煞炼魂幡 古战场万魂归吾
slug: 噬主成魔万魂幡饮血开锋
content_zh:
白骨幡杆如地狱毒龙出洞，直刺魁梧管事丹田！
虚幻的幡影凝于杆尖，化作一点吞噬万物的极暗，那是万魂幡雏形对血魂最本能的饥渴咆哮！
管事脸上的狞笑瞬间凝固，化为惊骇欲绝。
他拍落的灵力巨掌距离阴九幽天灵盖仅有三寸，劲风已压得他枯发倒竖！
但丹田要害处传来的、源自生命本能的恐怖警兆，让他浑身汗毛炸立！
“小畜生你敢！”
他嘶吼变调，强行收掌回护丹田，雄浑的灵力仓促间在腹部形成一道淡黄色光盾。
晚了！
噗嗤！
一声令人牙酸的、如同热刀刺入冷油的闷响！
那凝聚了数百怨灵魂源、数百淬炼骨基、融合了阴九幽心头精血与滔天恨意的白骨幡杆。
带着一股蛮横霸道的穿透意志，狠狠捅穿了那层仓促凝聚的灵力光盾！
如同烧红的铁钎捅穿薄纸！
杆尖那点极致的黑暗，贪婪地吻上了管事温热的、鼓荡着炼气三重灵力的丹田！
“呃啊——！
！”
凄厉到不似人声的惨嚎瞬间撕裂了矿坑的死寂！
魁梧管事眼珠暴凸，整张脸因极致的痛苦和无法言喻的恐惧而扭曲变形！
他能清晰地感觉到，一股冰冷、死寂、带着无上吞噬意志的力量，正顺着那根邪异的骨杆，如同亿万根贪婪的吸管，狠狠扎进了他苦修多年的丹田气海！
《万劫炼魂真经》——噬魂！

噬灵！
这一次的目标，不再是游荡的残魂，而是一个活生生的、灵力充沛的炼气修士！
“我的灵力！
我的魂！”
管事发出绝望的哀嚎，身体如同被抽走了所有骨头，剧烈地抽搐、痉挛！
他拼命鼓荡丹田灵力，试图震碎那根邪骨，驱逐那恐怖的吞噬之力！
淡黄色的灵力光芒在他体表疯狂闪烁、明灭，如同风中残烛。
但一切都是徒劳！
万魂幡的吞噬意志，霸道绝伦！
那白骨幡杆仿佛活了过来，表面的痛苦人脸符文血光大盛，发出无声的、贪婪的吮吸声！
管事苦修积攒的灵力，如同决堤的洪水，被那杆子疯狂抽取！
更可怕的是，一股源自灵魂深处的撕裂感传来，他的魂魄本源，竟也在被强行拉扯、吞噬！
“救我！
快杀了他！
杀了这魔头！”
管事朝着身后两个吓傻了的护卫发出最后凄厉的求救。
两个炼气一二重的护卫这才从这电光火石间的恐怖变故中惊醒，看着管事那迅速干瘪下去的身体和扭曲痛苦的面容，一股寒气从脚底板直冲天灵盖！
他们眼中充满了极致的恐惧，哪里还有半分贪婪？
怪叫一声，竟是不约而同地转身就逃！
只想离这吞噬活人的魔鬼越远越好！

“废物！
回来！”
content_en:
The white bone flag pole came out of the hole like a poisonous dragon from hell, piercing the burly steward's pubic area!
The illusive shadow of the flag condenses on the tip of the pole, turning into a point of darkness that devours all things. It is the most instinctive roar of hunger and thirst for the blood soul of the prototype of the Ten Thousand Souls Flag!
The ferocious smile on the steward's face instantly solidified and turned into horror.
The giant spiritual palm he knocked down was only three inches away from the Yinjiu Youtian Spirit Cap, and the strong wind had already made his withered hair stand on end!
But the terrifying warning signs coming from the vital parts of his dantian, originating from his life instinct, made the hairs on his body stand on end!
"How dare you, little beast!"
He roared in a different tone, and forced his palms back to protect his dantian. The powerful spiritual power formed a pale yellow light shield in his abdomen in a hurry.
It's too late!
Poof!
There was a heart-wrenching sound, like a hot knife piercing cold oil!
The white bone flag pole condensed the source of hundreds of resentful souls, hundreds of tempered bones, and fused the essence and blood of Yin Jiuyou's heart with the overwhelming hatred.
With a tyrannical penetrating will, he pierced through the hastily condensed spiritual power light shield!
Like a red-hot iron piercing through tissue paper!
The extreme darkness at the tip of the rod greedily kissed the steward's warm Dantian, which was filled with the third level of Qi refining spiritual power!
"Uh-huh!
! "
The screams that were too shrill to sound like human voices instantly tore apart the dead silence of the mine!
The burly steward's eyes bulged, and his entire face was distorted by extreme pain and unspeakable fear!
He could clearly feel that a cold, dead force with a supreme devouring will was following that evil bone rod, like billions of greedy straws, and piercing into the sea of ​​energy in his Dantian that he had practiced hard for many years!
"The Soul Refining Manual of Ten Thousand Tribulations" - Soul Devouring!
Devouring souls!
This time, the target is no longer a wandering remnant soul, but a living, spiritually powerful Qi Refining monk!
"My spiritual power!
my soul! "
The steward let out a desperate cry, and his body felt like all the bones had been taken away, twitching and convulsing violently!
He desperately mobilized the spiritual power of his Dantian, trying to shatter the evil bone and expel the terrifying devouring power!
The pale yellow spiritual light flashed crazily on his body, flickering on and off like a candle in the wind.
But it's all in vain!
The devouring will of the Ten Thousand Soul Banner is extremely domineering!
The bone flag pole seemed to come to life, and the painful human face runes on the surface glowed with blood, making a silent and greedy sucking sound!
The spiritual power accumulated by the steward through hard work was like a flood that burst a dam, being drawn away by the pole like crazy!
What's even more frightening is that a tearing feeling comes from the depths of his soul. The origin of his soul is also being forcibly pulled and swallowed!
"Help me!
Kill him quickly!
Kill this devil! "
The steward made his last desperate plea for help to the two frightened guards behind him.
The two guards at the first and second levels of Qi Refining woke up from the horrific incident in the lightning room. Looking at the steward's rapidly withering body and twisted and painful face, a cold air rushed from the soles of his feet to the sky!
Their eyes were full of extreme fear, where could there be any trace of greed?
With a strange scream, they turned around and ran away!
I just want to stay as far away from this devil as possible that devours living people!
"Trash!
Come back! "
